The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the case of rectangular matrix completion, it is possible to use simple gradient descent scheme to optimize a nonconvex function over the positive semidefinite cone.

, by using Burer-Monteiror factorization, the nonconvex optimization problem becomes tractable, and the convergence rate of the algorithm can be analyzed by a simple first order Taylor expansion of the objective.

, for the rectangular matrix completion setting, the Burer-Monteiror factorization is a viable alternative to the nuclear norm relaxation, and the gradient descent algorithm can be used to optimize the nonconvex objective.
